# KRN-005: IPv6 router advertisements are not switched off by a profile

- **Group:** Kernel settings
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

When the provider configures IPv6 through router advertisements, setting accept_ra=0 in a hardening profile removes the address and default route once the lifetime runs out, so IPv6 fails hours after the change. Warned only when a sysctl file sets it and a dynamic global IPv6 address is present.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra; ip -6 addr show scope global
```

## How to fix it

Leave net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra at its default where the provider uses router advertisements, or configure the address statically.

Run `stackward explain KRN-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
